build: Amazon Redshift Serverless 1.0.539508 (workgroup compat), external schemas on AWS Glue resource links to the federated catalog with SOURCE_VENDED, Redshift Data API with boto3 1.44.4

s3.note: The check reads the same data from tables whose names have no capitals. Without it: AWS Glue catalog federation leaves out the tables whose names mix lowercase and uppercase letters, as its connection property CATALOG_CASING_FILTER takes LOWERCASE_ONLY or UPPERCASE_ONLY: AwsClientException: EntityNotFoundException from glue - Table does not exist: cdc_measurement.c8y_temperature

views.note: AWS Glue catalog federation discovers "Iceberg tables in external catalogs" (docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/catalog-federation.html) and none of the catalog's views, not even those with lowercase names such as view_alarm.alarm; the query fails with AwsClientException: EntityNotFoundException from glue - Table does not exist: view_measurement.c8y_temperature

large-values.note: With the lowercase-tables switch: Expected 16384 chars and 32768 bytes of 'ä', got 8191 chars, 16382 bytes of ['ä']. Redshift reads an Iceberg string as varchar(16384) and truncates longer strings (docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/querying-iceberg-supported-data-types.html).

incremental-read.note: Redshift reads an Iceberg table as of one point in time (AS OF TIMESTAMP) and has no query for the rows appended between two snapshots (docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/querying-iceberg.html).
